title: Integral diagonal unit and trace counit construction
statement: Fix ell, E, a separated finite-type base Y in the standing characteristic setting, and preservation witnesses hq and hr for the prescribed restricted pullback-twist-shift and pushforward. For every diagonal coefficient family there is exactly one pair of natural transformations whose components equal the canonical four-arrow unit and inverse-projection trace counit, transported by the positive Tate-line comparison. This asserts no triangle identities.

source.place: Paragraph (1), diagonal unit, trace counit and the two triangle identities

proof.text: The positive integral Tate-line comparison fixes the native ambient endpoints.
Proper base change and the integral proper projection formula invert the precise exchange and projection maps on the localizing closures.

Compose the normalized section, inverse diagonal tensor comparison, diagonal class, inverse projection and inverse exchange for the unit; use inverse projection and trace for the counit. Naturality of each canonical factor gives naturality of the pastes and fullness restricts them.
For uniqueness cancel the endpoint comparison in each unit component, use the counit component equations, and apply extensionality of natural transformations.

theorem integralUnitCounit_existsUnique
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [∀ x : ProjectiveLine Y, Invertible (ℓ : (ProjectiveLine Y).residueField x)]
    [∀ x : diagonalSurface Y, Invertible (ℓ : (diagonalSurface Y).residueField x)]
    (hq : ∀ K, IntegralCompactSupport.localizing
        (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) Y K →
      IntegralCompactSupport.localizing (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val)
        (ProjectiveSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) Y)
        ((pullTwistShift ℓ E (ProjectiveSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) Y ↘ Y) 1).obj K))
    (hr : ∀ K, IntegralCompactSupport.localizing (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val)
        (ProjectiveSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) Y) K →
      IntegralCompactSupport.localizing (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) Y
        ((IntegralCompactSupport.push (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val)
          (ProjectiveSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) Y ↘ Y)).obj K))
    (family : Family ℓ Y) :
    ∃! a : IntegralUnitCounitType ℓ E Y hq hr,
      IntegralUnitCounitNormalized ℓ E Y hq hr family a
